definitions.explanation: Sound produced by humans or animals through vocalization. Includes speaking, singing, calling out, etc.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{声|こえ}で{話|はな}してください。
examples.english: Please speak in a loud voice.

notes:
Different from {音|おと} (sound) which is for general sounds. {声|こえ} specifically refers to vocal sounds.

Common expressions:
- {声|こえ}を{出|だ}す (to make a sound/speak up)
- {声|こえ}をかける (to call out to someone).
